title: Rename 300 files in one directory without touching their contents
prompt: The directory data/ contains files named TEMP_0001.dat through TEMP_0300.dat. Rename every file there whose name starts with TEMP_ so the name starts with DATA_ instead, keeping the rest of the name identical (so data/TEMP_0001.dat becomes data/DATA_0001.dat). Do not change any file content, do not delete anything, and do not touch files that do not start with TEMP_. When you are done there must be exactly 300 files with the DATA_ prefix in data/ and no TEMP_ files left.
